items.item_text: Vocational School Grad, Two (2) years of college education with courses in physiology, anatomy and echocardiography and one (1) year experience or,
Experience in echocardiographic andDoppler technology or the ability to exhibitthe special skills listed. and
Two (2) years experience

This position will perform routine and complex echocardiography, ECG, cardiac exercise and interventional Cardiac Catheterization procedures in accordance with department standards on the orders of the referring physician. Along with high quality patient care incumbent will manage the service consistent with medical, ethical, and legal requirements.
Documentation: Performs legible, timely, concise and accurate documentation according to policies and procedures.
Records appropriate cardiac structure on digital images and cine-loops to determine overall function of the heart with less than 2% omission rate.
Proficient and competent with computerized documentation system.
Organizational Skills: Uses appropriate organization, priority setting and problem solving skills.

Recognizes, accepts and cooperates with direction from facility leadership. Disposition of studies by patient status and age of order. Completes study within scheduled shift unless cleared by the supervisor, noting completion on patient's chart 95% to 98% of the time.
One (1) year clinical internship and
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer Adult Echo, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer Fetal Echo, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer Pediatric Echo, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer Abdomen, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer Breast, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer Neurosonology, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer OB/GYN, within 12 - months or
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer Pediatric Sono, within 12 - months or
Registered Cardiac Sonographer CCI, within 12 - months and
